subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add registerControlUiEntryPoint as a separate public plugin UI API, or fold launch-token behavior into the existing surface: "tab" descriptor contract with one sandboxed browser trust model?
rationale: The branch changes public plugin SDK/Gateway/UI contracts and browser security boundaries, so automation cannot choose the permanent API shape or trust model safely.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptors
options.body: Reuse the current tab descriptor seam, add any missing launch-token semantics there, and keep one documented plugin page contract.

options.title: Approve Separate Entry Points
options.body: Accept a second plugin UI API, but document why tab descriptors are insufficient and own the resulting compatibility surface.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it in favor of a narrower RFC/API proposal before implementation continues.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptors
recommendation.body: Reuse the current tab descriptor seam, add any missing launch-token semantics there, and keep one documented plugin page contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged host-hook foundation and related RFC direction that this API would extend.
